questions.prompt: What does this print?
questions.code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
  ch := make(chan int, 1)
  ch <- 7
  close(ch)
  v, ok := <-ch
  fmt.Println(v, ok)
  v, ok = <-ch
  fmt.Println(v, ok)
}
questions.explanation: Buffered value is received with ok=true; subsequent receive on closed empty channel yields zero value and ok=false.
